points.title: 喺 hai2: at, in
points.explain: 喺 marks where something is or happens: 我喺屋企 "I'm at home". Don't mix it up with 係 hai6 "to be". Only the tone differs.

points.title: 嘅 ge3: 's, of
points.explain: 嘅 links an owner or a description to a noun: 我嘅 "my", 好食嘅嘢 "tasty stuff".
points.pattern: 嘅(?![咩囖啦喇啊呀嘛呢吖喎噃咋啫㗎]|$)

points.title: Measure word as "the" or "my"
points.explain: A measure word plus a noun can mean "the …": 隻貓好得意 "the cat is cute". Owner + measure word + noun is "my …": 我部電話 "my phone".
points.pattern: [我你佢][部隻本架間條張對個支枝]

points.title: 咗 zo2: done
points.explain: After a verb, 咗 shows the action has happened: 我食咗飯 "I've eaten".

points.title: 緊 gan2: -ing
points.explain: After a verb, 緊 shows the action is in progress: 我食緊飯 "I'm eating".

points.title: 過 gwo3: ever
points.explain: After a verb, 過 means "have done before": 我去過 "I've been (there)".
points.pattern: [去食睇見試聽做玩讀講學用買行搭坐飲到嚟]過

points.title: 未 mei6: not yet
points.explain: 未 means "not yet". 食咗飯未呀? "Have you eaten yet?" is answered 未 or 食咗.

points.title: 冇 + verb: didn't
points.explain: 冇 before a verb means "didn't": 我冇去 "I didn't go".
points.pattern: (?<!有)冇[去食睇見嚟返買講做聽搵打話答知問]

points.title: 唔好 / 咪: don't
points.explain: 唔好 + verb means "don't …". 咪 mai5 is a shorter, blunter "don't": 咪嘈 "don't be noisy".

points.title: A唔A questions
points.explain: Say the verb, then 唔, then the verb again to ask yes or no: 去唔去? "going or not?". For 有 the form is 有冇.

points.title: 係咪 hai6 mai6: is it that…?
points.explain: 係咪 is a short form of 係唔係 and asks for confirmation: 你係咪學生?

points.title: Question words
points.explain: 咩 me1 or 乜嘢 mat1 je5 "what", 邊個 bin1 go3 "who", 邊度 bin1 dou6 "where", 點解 dim2 gaai2 "why", 幾時 gei2 si4 "when", 幾多 gei2 do1 "how many", 點 dim2 "how". The question word stays where the answer would go.
points.pattern: 乜嘢|邊個|邊度|點解|幾時|幾多

points.title: X + adjective + 過 + Y
points.explain: To compare, put 過 after the adjective: 佢高過我 "he's taller than me".
points.pattern: [高大矮細快慢靚平貴長短多少遠近重輕難易叻]過[我你佢]

points.title: 畀 bei2: give
points.explain: When giving, the thing comes before the person: 畀本書我 "give me the book".

points.title: 嚟 去 返: come, go, go back
points.explain: 嚟 lai4 "come" (also heard as lei4), 去 heoi3 "go", 返 faan1 "go back (somewhere you belong)": 返屋企 "go home", 返工 "go to work".

points.title: V + 得: can
points.explain: Verb + 得 means it can be done or is allowed: 食得 "edible, can eat". 唔 + verb + 得 means it can't: 唔去得 "can't go".
points.pattern: 唔[食去睇做行講買玩用試聽見飲坐]得|[食去睇做行講買玩用試聽見飲坐]得(?:晒|$|呀|啊|嘅|喎)|[食去睇做行講買玩用試聽見飲坐]得唔得

points.title: 開 hoi1: usually
points.explain: After a verb, 開 marks something you have been doing regularly: 我用開呢部電腦 "this is the computer I normally use".
points.pattern: [用食睇做買玩]開(?![會工學門車])

points.title: 住 zyu6: keep -ing
points.explain: After a verb, 住 marks a continuing state: 等住 "wait (and keep waiting)", 坐住 "sitting".

points.title: 吓 haa5: a bit
points.explain: After a verb, 吓 means "a little, have a go": 試吓 "give it a try".
points.pattern: [試睇聽揀問望諗等學講跑行]吓|[試睇聽揀問望諗等學講跑行]下

points.title: 埋 maai4: too, finish off
points.explain: After a verb, 埋 means "as well" or "finish the rest": 等埋我 "wait for me too", 食埋佢 "finish it off".

points.title: 返 faan1: again, back
points.explain: After a verb, 返 means doing it again or getting back to it: 瞓返覺 "go back to sleep".

points.title: 喇 laa3: now, already
points.explain: 喇 marks a new situation: 夠喇 "that's enough now". People often write 啦 for it too.

points.title: 喎 wo3 / wo5
points.explain: wo3 shows you've just noticed something: 落雨喎 "oh, it's raining". wo5 reports what someone else said.

points.title: 囉 lo1: obviously
points.explain: 囉 says "that's how it is, obviously": 噉咪得囉 "then that's fine, isn't it".

points.title: 咩 me1: really?
points.explain: At the end of a question, 咩 shows surprise or doubt: 真係咩? "really?".

points.title: 嘅 ge3 at the end
points.explain: 嘅 at the end of a sentence says "this is so": 佢唔會嚟嘅 "he won't come".

points.title: 噃 bo3: mind you
points.explain: 噃 points something out as a reminder: 好貴噃 "it's pricey, mind you".

points.title: 啩 gwaa3: I guess
points.explain: 啩 makes a guess: 佢唔嚟啩 "I guess he isn't coming".
